name: Adam Krylov
source:
"As you become an adult and understand things better, people can't say the things that should be said."

Teuta and Luka's childhood friend and anchorman of New Sieg's news show, "The Zero Hour". He's popular as he doesn't fixate on particular political sides and his stance is to remain neutral. His clean-cut good looks make him popular with women and sometimes he's treated more like your typical television star; appearing in not only prime time news shows but also radio and variety shows.
